Modron - 1.4.0

**Note: ** This version introduces a new grant schema and workflow please backup your world before updating.

Additions / Changes

  • Adds an experimental setting to change the primary color across the system. Note: This feature is just a test feature.
  • Updates code editor component so that it can be popped out.

Grants

  • Adds Currency, Maneuver, Spell, and Setting Grants.
  • Adds death saving throws and concentration saves to expertise grant.
  • Adds death saving throws and concentration saves to Proficiency grant.
  • Adds support to select multiple groups in Proficiency Grant.
  • Adds support to select across categories in Proficiency Grant.
  • Adds hit dice context to healing bonuses and grants.
  • Applied data for a grant now lives on the item itself.
  • Adds the ability to set the selection type on document grants.
  • Adds the ability to set an open selection of documents on a document grant with filters.
  • Adds the ability to override data of a granted document via some preset options and changes.
  • Adds the ability for a damage resistance grant to upgrade the damage type to immunity if the actor is already resistant.
  • Adds the ability for a skill grant to grant expertiseDice if the original skill is already proficient.
  • Adds proficiency property to death saving throws and concentration saves.
  • Migrates grant.label to grant.name.
  • Migrates grant.grantType to grant.type.
  • Upgrades grant workflow.
  • Grant application optimizations.
  • actor.system.grants is no longer supported.

Fixes

  • Fixes migrations not updating migration records.
  • Fixes a bug in the application of grants.
  • Fixes token bars not showing.
  • Fixes outdated calling of source in hacking filter config.
  • Fixes some Foundry deprecations.
  • Fixes actor settings page not scrolling.
